description: This file implements CRC calculation functions optimized with ARM NEON intrinsics, including functions for byte swapping, shifting, and folding data for CRC computations, as well as class methods for CRC calculation based on different polynomials.

methods.name: neon_bswap
methods.description: Performs byte swap on a 64x2 vector using NEON instructions.

methods.name: neon_shift_right
methods.description: Shifts a 64x2 vector to the right by a specified number of bytes.

methods.name: neon_shift_right_4
methods.description: Shifts a 64x2 vector to the right by 4 bytes.

methods.name: neon_shift_left
methods.description: Shifts a 64x2 vector to the left by a specified number of bytes.

methods.name: neon_shift_left_4
methods.description: Shifts a 64x2 vector to the left by 4 bytes.

methods.name: neon_clear_lower_4byte
methods.description: Clears the lower 4 bytes of a 64x2 vector.

methods.name: neon_vmull_p64
methods.description: Performs polynomial multiplication on 64-bit vectors with NEON.

methods.name: crc32_folding_round
methods.description: Performs a folding round in CRC calculation using NEON.

methods.name: crc32_reduce_128_to_64
methods.description: Reduces 128-bit data to 64 bits in CRC calculation.

methods.name: neon_safe_load
methods.description: Safely loads data into a NEON register, handling spans of data.

methods.name: crc32_reduce_64_to_32
methods.description: Reduces 64-bit fold data to 32 bits in CRC calculation.

methods.name: neon_set_u64
methods.description: Creates a 128-bit NEON vector from two 64-bit integers.

methods.name: crc32_calc_pclmulqdq
methods.description: Calculates CRC using polynomial multiplication and NEON optimizations.
